_comment: Copy to schedule.json and edit while the app runs — it re-reads on change.
Check it with: npm run schedule:check
timezone + date are set ONCE for the whole file, so each match is just a
wall-clock time. Set timezone to whatever zone your SOURCE shows —
Liquipedia converts to your own zone when logged in, so copying what you
see is usually right. IANA name (Asia/Tbilisi) or offset (+04:00).
Put date on a match to override the file default for a late-night slot.
teams is one field: "Team A vs Team B". Tags and the short stage label
(Upper Bracket R2 -> UB2) are derived; set tagA/tagB/stageShort to override.
The bracket is derived from these matches, so there is only one list to keep
straight. Add "score": "2-0" when a match ends: it drops out of the
countdown and shows its result in the bracket. One edit per finished game.
Add a "bracket" array only if you want to override that entirely.
The bar shows start times in YOUR local zone, not the tournament's.
